goal: Evaluate Yasuke Crow allegiance and Xoah branch schema
body: 🧬 Canon candidate captured as shard 22410@db5. Proposed resolution: Yasuke is Crow by blood but not faction-loyal, ideally anti-Crow/post-Crow/apostate. This turns 'The Day a Thousand Crows Died' into inherited ancestral trauma and identity conflict. Yasuke is not fundamentally Xoah's antagonist; he is a temporal counterforce preserving the necessary Oda loop and carrying the sword backward. Whitelock is the cleaner ideological opponent: Whitelock repairs causality damaged by Shadow Xoah to preserve baseline time, while Yasuke protects the loop that must exist for Xoah to be born. Proposed branch notation: X1 = Xoah Prime/origin baseline, X2 = evolved mainline Xoah, X3 = Xoah Queen/Throne culmination, X-side = Dark/Shadow Xoah lateral branch, intentionally outside the ordinal ladder.
resolution: Captured as shard 22410@db5. Yasuke apostate counterforce and branch notation acknowledged.
